annotations.text:
Everything here is real xFPL content, not lorem.
The four grey tiles say "Not connected" because nothing measures those yet — the dashboard cannot show a number nobody recorded.
Click anything to select it, then edit colours, spacing, type and copy in the properties panel. Double-click text to retype it in place.
The approval surface is the point of the whole system: an executive can propose this, and only you can advance it.
